The journal is append-only and refuses last-write-wins, so an event recorded before it was applied cannot be updated in place to carry its result commit. Activation must be designed around an applied event being a NEW record, not around mutating one.
Tauri does not enable the ml feature, so the shipped desktop app has no path to an activated model today. Any reachability claim must be earned by a packaging gate, not assumed from library code.
